newsitem.title: UK: Winterthur links with UK building society.
newsitem.headline: Winterthur links with UK building society.

text.p: Swiss-based Winterthur Insurance Co said on Sunday it proposes to form a joint venture with British home-lender Skipton Building Society.
Winterthur Life, the company's UK life insurance and pensions unit, said in a statement, "The move signals Wintherthur's intention to be a major player in the mortgage services arena."
The company is already involved in the UK housing market through a network of independently-owned estate agents which places some one billion stg of mortgage apllications with existing lenders.
It said the link with Skipton was "timed to take advantage of the uplift in mortgage demand and strengthening house prices."

Wintherthur Life chairman John Finan said, "The aim is to make home buying quicker and more efficient for the consumer by providing all the services at the house hunter's most convenient location -- the estate agent."
He said the Skipton link would be followed by other non-life insurance arrangements which would include household and other insurance products in addition to personal lending.

The news is the latest move in a shake up of Britain's personal financial services industry which has included several of the largest building societies opting to abandon their mutually-owned status and become banks owned by shareholders.
It also follows the first signs that house prices in Britain might be rising after a prolonged period of depression.
